content_data.meeting_title: Fleet Management Platform - Performance Optimization Sprint Review
agenda_items: Discuss microservices architecture scalability for multi-tenant deployment
key_decisions: Adopt Kubernetes horizontal pod autoscaling for the analytics service to handle peak load periods
Implement Redis caching layer for frequently accessed fleet configuration data
Migrate from PostgreSQL to TimescaleDB for time-series vehicle data to improve query performance by 60%
technical_blockers: Legacy monolith dependencies preventing full microservices decomposition
Third-party OEM API documentation incomplete, causing integration delays for two major automotive clients

Inconsistent data schemas across different vehicle manufacturers requiring extensive transformation logic
